annotations.title: Get a Docmint link with settings preset

description: Build a link to one Docmint tool with its settings filled in, such as compress-pdf with level=strong or split-pdf with mode=range and ranges=1-3. The person opens the link and adds the file in their browser, where it is processed on their device. Settings a tool doesn't accept are ignored and listed in the result. This tool only builds the link: it does not receive or process the file.

settings.description: Tool settings by name. See find_pdf_tool or list_pdf_tools for each tool's settings and allowed values.

name: get_tool_link
